description: SANDBOX ONLY. Grant fake account credit to the sandbox account so paid operations (register/renew/transfer) can keep being exercised after funds run out. Requires a sandbox API key (`pk1_sb_…`). Optional `amount_cents` (integer US cents) (default 100000 = $1000; capped 1,000,000). Returns the new balance. With a live key this endpoint is not available.

amount.description: Deprecated alias of `amount_cents`, same unit (integer US cents). Send `amount_cents` instead.

amount_cents.description: Fake credit to add (default 100000 = $1000; max 1000000). Integer US cents: 803 means $8.03, not $803.

name: sandbox_topup
title: Sandbox Topup
